topic: Booking a Trial Piano Lesson for a Child

script.title: FIRST PIANO TRIAL
script.scene_zh: 鋼琴教室 · 預約試聽
script.story_hook: A shy six-year-old, one free trial, one kind teacher.
script.intro_zh: 一位害羞的六歲孩子、一堂免費試聽、一位和藹的老師。
script.welcome_en: Hi, welcome to a first piano booking. Listen for handy school phrases.
script.welcome_zh: 嗨，歡迎來到第一次預約鋼琴課。留意實用的學校相關說法。
script.outro: And that's one trial booked with ease. Listen again and say it out loud.
script.outro_zh: 一堂試聽課就這樣輕鬆約好了。再聽一次，大聲跟著說說看。
script.practice_intro_en: Now let's repeat each line together.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在我們一起逐句跟讀。
script.title_quote: Six is a great age to begin
script.char_a_description: a gentle father in his early forties with short black hair, thin wire-frame glasses, a soft grey cardigan over a white shirt, dark trousers, and a lean build
script.char_b_description: a patient piano teacher in her fifties with shoulder-length blonde hair in a low ponytail, round glasses, a burgundy blouse, a long floral skirt, and a petite build

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, I'd like to book a trial piano lesson.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ aɪd laɪk tə bʊk ə ˈtɹaɪəl piˈænoʊ ˈlɛsən/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，我想預約一堂鋼琴試聽課。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lovely, how old is your child?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlʌvli haʊ ˈoʊld ɪz jɔɹ ˈtʃaɪld/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，你家小孩幾歲？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She'll be six this coming winter.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃil bi sɪks ðɪs ˈkʌmɪŋ ˈwɪnɾɚ/
dialogue.zh: 她今年冬天就滿六歲了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Six is a great age to begin.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪks ɪz ə ɡɹeɪt eɪdʒ tə bɪˈɡɪn/
dialogue.zh: 六歲是很棒的啟蒙年齡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, we were worried she was too young.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd wi wɚ ˈwɝiəd ʃi wəz tə ˈjʌŋ/
dialogue.zh: 還好，我們擔心她年紀太小。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not at all, under six is our youngest.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt æt ɔl ˈʌndɚ sɪks ɪz ɑɹ ˈjʌŋɪst/
dialogue.zh: 才不會，六歲以下是我們最小的組。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nice. Do you teach group or private?
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs du ju titʃ ɡɹup ɔɹ ˈpɹaɪvət/
dialogue.zh: 不錯。你們教團體課還是一對一？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Both, but beginners do well in groups.
dialogue.phonetic: /boʊθ bʌt bɪˈɡɪnɚz du wɛl ɪn ɡɹups/
dialogue.zh: 兩種都有，但初學者上團體課不錯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hmm, she's pretty shy around other kids.
dialogue.phonetic: /həm ʃiz ˈpɹɪti ʃaɪ əˈɹaʊnd ˈʌðɚ kɪdz/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，她在其他小孩面前很害羞。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's common, she'll warm up quickly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ˈkɑmən ʃil wɔɹm ʌp ˈkwɪkli/
dialogue.zh: 很常見，她會很快就適應。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many children are in one group?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ ˈmɛni ˈtʃɪldɹən ɑɹ ɪn wʌn ɡɹup/
dialogue.zh: 一個團體有幾個小孩？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just four, so everyone gets attention.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst fɔɹ soʊ ˈɛvɹiˌwʌn ɡɛts əˈtɛnʃən/
dialogue.zh: 只有四個，所以每個人都顧得到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That sounds better than a crowded room.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ˈsaʊndz ˈbɛɾɚ ðæn ə ˈkɹaʊdɪd ɹum/
dialogue.zh: 聽起來比擠滿人的教室好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly. Would you like to see the space?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli wʊd ju laɪk tə si ðə speɪs/
dialogue.zh: 就是。你想先看看教室嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes please, is it upstairs?
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs pliz ɪz ɪt ˌʌpˈstɛɹz/
dialogue.zh: 好的，請問在樓上嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is, right past the little front desk.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ɹaɪt pæst ðə ˈlɪɾəl fɹʌnt dɛsk/
dialogue.zh: 在樓上，過了那個小前台就是。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great. Now, how much is a single lesson?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹeɪt naʊ haʊ mʌtʃ ɪz ə ˈsɪŋɡəl ˈlɛsən/
dialogue.zh: 太好了。一堂課多少錢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twenty five, and the trial one is free.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtwɛnti faɪv ænd ðə ˈtɹaɪəl wʌn ɪz fɹi/
dialogue.zh: 二十五，而且試聽那堂是免費的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh nice, so we can just look first.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ naɪs soʊ wi kən ˈdʒʌst lʊk ˈfɝst/
dialogue.zh: 噢真好，所以我們可以先觀望。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, no pressure at all.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌv kɔɹs noʊ ˈpɹɛʃɚ æt ɔl/
dialogue.zh: 當然，完全沒有壓力。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That helps, we're still unsure about piano.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt hɛlps wɪɹ stɪl ʌnˈʃʊɹ əˈbaʊt piˈænoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 這就有幫助了，我們對鋼琴還在猶豫。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Totally fair. Many families start with one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtoʊɾəli fɛɹ ˈmɛni ˈfæməliz stɑɹt wɪð wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 很合理，很多家庭都是先上堂試聽。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we need to buy a piano right away?
dialogue.phonetic: /du wi nid tə baɪ ə piˈænoʊ ɹaɪt əˈweɪ/
dialogue.zh: 我們需要馬上買一架鋼琴嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, you can rent one for now.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ju kən ɹɛnt ˈwʌn fɚ naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 不用，你可以先租一台。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Rent? Um, how does that work?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɹɛnt ʌm haʊ dʌz ðæt ˈwɝk/
dialogue.zh: 租？嗯，那是怎麼運作的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thirty a month, and it counts toward buying.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈθɝti ə mʌnθ ænd ɪt kaʊnts təˈwɔɹd ˈbaɪɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 一個月三十，之後可以抵買琴的錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, that's actually a smart deal.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ðæts ˈæktʃuəli ə smɑɹt dil/
dialogue.zh: 噢，這其實是很聰明的做法。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Well, most people try a year first.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl moʊst ˈpipəl tɹaɪ ə jɪɹ ˈfɝst/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，多數人都先租一年試試。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if she hates it after a month?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ɪf ʃi heɪts ɪt ˈæftɚ ə mʌnθ/
dialogue.zh: 如果她一個月後不喜歡呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then you stop, no fee, no hard feelings.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ju stɑp noʊ fi noʊ hɑɹd ˈfilɪŋz/
dialogue.zh: 那就停，不收費，也不傷感情。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, I was worried about a long contract.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd aɪ wəz ˈwɝiəd əˈbaʊt ə ˈlɔŋ ˈkɑntɹækt/
dialogue.zh: 好，我本來擔心要簽長約。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No contracts here, we keep it simple.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈkɑnˌtɹækts hɪɹ wi kip ɪt ˈsɪmpəl/
dialogue.zh: 這裡沒有合約，我們保持簡單。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect. When do lessons fit a six year old?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɝfɪkt wɛn du ˈlɛsənz fɪt ə sɪks jɪɹ oʊld/
dialogue.zh: 太好了。六歲的孩子幾點上課？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Saturday mornings, or after school Wednesdays.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsætɚˌdeɪ ˈmɔɹnɪŋz ɔɹ ˈæftɚ skul ˈwɛnzˌdeɪz/
dialogue.zh: 星期六早上，或是星期三放學後。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hmm, Saturdays are our busy soccer day.
dialogue.phonetic: /həm ˈsætəˌdeɪz ɑɹ ˈɑɚ ˈbizi ˈsɑkɚ deɪ/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，星期六是我們忙碌的足球日。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then Wednesdays, they love that slot too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ˈwɛnzˌdeɪz ðeɪ lʌv ðæt slɑt tu/
dialogue.zh: 那就星期三，那個時段大家也很愛。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long is one lesson for a beginner?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ lɔŋ ɪz wʌn ˈlɛsən fɚ ə bɪˈɡɪnɚ/
dialogue.zh: 初學者一堂課多長？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just thirty minutes, plenty for now.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst ˈθɝti ˈmɪnəts ˈplɛnti fɚ naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 只有三十分鐘，現在很夠了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's short, will she really learn much?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ʃɔɹt wɪl ʃi ˈɹiəli ˈlɝn ˈmʌtʃ/
dialogue.zh: 好短，她真的學得會很多嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, short and often works better than long.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ʃɔɹt ænd ˈɔfən wɝks ˈbɛɾɚ ðæn ˈlɔŋ/
dialogue.zh: 會，短而頻繁，比一次上很久更有用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fair point. Do you hold a recital sometime?
dialogue.phonetic: /fɛɹ pɔɪnt du ju ˈhoʊld ə rɪˈsaɪtəl ˈsʌmˌtaɪm/
dialogue.zh: 說得也是。你們會舉辦音樂發表會嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Every spring, the kids play for families.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛvɹi spɹɪŋ ðə kɪdz pleɪ fɚ ˈfæməliz/
dialogue.zh: 每年春天，孩子們彈給家長聽。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, so she'd perform in front of people?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ soʊ ʃi d pɚˈfɔɹm ɪn fɹʌnt əv ˈpipəl/
dialogue.zh: 噢，所以她要在大家面前表演？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One easy song, it's a proud moment.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ˈizi sɔŋ ɪts ə pɹaʊd ˈmoʊmənt/
dialogue.zh: 一首簡單的曲子，那是值得驕傲的時刻。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We might cry, honestly.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi maɪt kɹaɪ ˈɑnəstli/
dialogue.zh: 老實說，我們會哭的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Most parents do, it's very sweet.
dialogue.phonetic: /moʊst ˈpɛɹənts du ɪts ˈvɛɹi swit/
dialogue.zh: 多數家長都會，那很溫馨。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, let's book that free trial lesson.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ lɛts bʊk ðæt fɹi ˈtɹaɪəl ˈlɛsən/
dialogue.zh: 好，那幫我們預約那堂免費試聽課。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wonderful, next Wednesday at four?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwʌndɚfəl nɛkst ˈwɛnzˌdeɪ æt fɔɹ/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，下週三四點可以嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Four works. Should I bring her with me?
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔɹ wɝks ʃʊd aɪ ˈbrɪŋ hɚ wɪð mi/
dialogue.zh: 四點可以。要帶她一起來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Please do, she picks up the vibe fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /pliz du ʃi ˈpɪks ʌp ðə ˈvaɪb ˈfæst/
dialogue.zh: 請帶來，她很快就融入氣氛。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I sign anything today or later?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ saɪn ˈɛniθɪŋ təˈdeɪ ɔɹ ˈleɪɾɚ/
dialogue.zh: 我今天要簽東西還是之後再說？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just a short form, you can do it here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈdʒʌst ə ʃɔɹt ˈfɔɹm ju kən du ɪt hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 只要一張短表，你在這裡填就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great. What should she wear that day?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹeɪt wʌt ʃʊd ʃi ˈwɛɹ ðæt ˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 太好了。那天她該穿什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Comfortable clothes, and shoes come off.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkʌmftəbəl kloʊðz ænd ʃuz kʌm ɔf/
dialogue.zh: 舒服的衣物，鞋子要脫下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Shoes off, got it, we'll remember.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃuz ɔf ɡɑɾ ɪt wil ɹɪˈmɛmbɚ/
dialogue.zh: 鞋子要脫，記下了，我們會記得。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And if she's nervous, just stay near.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ɪf ʃiɹ ˈnɝvəs dʒʌst steɪ nɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 如果她緊張，你待在旁邊就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That makes me feel better too, honestly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt meɪks mi fil ˈbɛɾɚ tu ˈɑnəstli/
dialogue.zh: 老實說這樣我也放心多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You're welcome, Wednesdays are the best.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊɹ ˈwɛlkəm ˈwɛnzˌdeɪz ɑɹ ðə bɛst/
dialogue.zh: 不客氣，星期三的時段最好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thank you, we'll see you next week.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ju wil si ju ˈnɛkst ˈwik/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝你，下週見。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Can't wait to meet your little pianist.
dialogue.phonetic: /kænt weɪt tə mit jɔɹ ˈlɪɾəl ˈpiənɪst/
dialogue.zh: 好期待見到你家的小鋼琴家。

script.youtube_title_en: "Six Is a Great Age to Begin" — Booking a First Piano Trial
script.youtube_description:
「六歲是很棒的啟蒙年齡」——第一次幫小孩預約鋼琴課，到底要問哪些事？這一集是 60 句沉浸式英語聽力練習，場景就在鋼琴教室的預約桌前。

你會聽到：說明孩子年齡與分組、問團體課還是一對一、害羞的小孩適合哪種；詢問學費、免費試聽、先租琴再買琴；不想簽長約時怎麼確認；還有春季音樂發表會與上課時間安排。

整段對話只用 A2 初級單字與日常短句，反覆出現的是美國家長真實的語感：um、well、so、oh、really。聽完你就會用：I'd like to book、How much is、What if、Do you hold、let's book。

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，請大聲跟著唸，讓舌頭先學會，腦袋自然就記住。

不用背，多聽就會用。每天一集，把英文聽成直覺。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish｜喜歡的話請按訂閱與小鈴鐺。
script.youtube_description_en:
"Six is a great age to begin" — what do you actually ask when booking a first piano trial for your child? This is a 60-line immersive English listening practice set right at the lesson desk.

You will hear: sharing your child's age and class group, choosing group or private for a shy kid, asking the price and about a free trial, renting before buying, checking there's no long contract, and the every-spring recital.

Everything stays in A2-level words, with the small talk parents really use: um, well, so, oh, really. By the end you'll own phrases like I'd like to book, How much is, What if, and let's book.

The last chapter is a line-by-line listen-and-repeat workout, so speak out loud and let your mouth learn first.

No memorizing needed — just listen often and it sticks.

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish — subscribe for a new scene every day.
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】🎧鋼琴試聽英文｜團體課與一對一・先租琴再買・春季音樂會｜害羞小孩第一次上課｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧聽力口說練習｜後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
小孩剛滿六歲，你想帶她去試一堂鋼琴課，可是團課還是一對一？要先買琴還是可以租？會不會一簽就是長期合約？

這一集帶大家走進一間鋼琴教室，從報年齡、選班別、問學費與免費試聽，一路聽到租琴抵扣、春季音樂會與預約時間，共 60 句連續真實對話。

你會聽到：
🎹 問班別：Do you teach group or private?
💰 問學費：Great. Now, how much is a single lesson?
🎁 先觀望：Oh nice, so we can just look first.
🎼 音樂會：Every spring, the kids play for families.

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習：每一句先聽兩遍，再跟著大聲說一遍，跟著 um、well、really 這些小詞把整句的節奏唸順。🎧

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背單字、不用學文法，多聽就會用。只要跟著這位爸爸在教室裡問一圈，下次自己替孩子約課，話就從嘴邊自己冒出來。

祝你家小琴家第一次上課開開心心。
